correctness.rationale: PASS. For norm-one x in c_0(I;C) and norm-one complex-linear functional f with f(x)=1, equality in the triangle inequality forces nonnegative t_j=f_jx_j summing to one. For diagonal isometry U with phases r ± i sqrt(1-r²) at p,q and 1 elsewhere, every state value is a convex combination whose real part is >=r; x=e_p+e_q, f=(e_p*+e_q*)/2 attains r. Coordinate-state restricted values have modulus exactly 1. Thus c(U)=r, c_beta(U)=||U||=1, saturating the universal norm-one deficit 1-r. Lipschitz estimates on state infima prove perturbative positivity for ||E||<min(r,(1-r)/2). This handles arbitrary index sets, r in (0,1), and complex field. Independently checked 231 exact rational simplex states at r=3/5.
